description: This file defines the class SeptaDependentEndpoint, a generic Java class extending Endpoint, which manages dependencies and filtering logic for a sequence of seven endpoints with associated request and response types.

classes.name: SeptaDependentEndpoint
classes.description: A generic class representing an endpoint with seven dependencies, applying a SeptaOperator filter to combine them.

methods.name: SeptaDependentEndpoint
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies and filter, applying the filter to dependencies.

methods.name: getDownstream
methods.description: Returns a list of the seven dependent endpoints.

methods.name: deepClone
methods.description: Creates a deep clone of the endpoint, including dependencies and filter.

methods.name: withDownstream
methods.description: Replaces dependencies with a provided list after assertions, returning a new endpoint instance.
